```{r}
library(rvest)
library(tidyverse)
library(httr)
```

Import NSDUH

```{r}
url = "https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015.htm"

drug_use_html = 
  read_html(url) 
```

Pull the table out

```{r}
marj_df = 
drug_use_html |>
  html_table() |>
  first() |>
  slice(-1)
```

##Imort some Star Wars Data

pull in the html

```{r}
swm_html = 
  read_html_live("https://www.imdb.com/list/ls070150896/") 
```

```{r}
swm_title_vec = 
  swm_html |>
  html_elements(".ipc-title-link-wrapper .ipc-title__text") |>
  html_text()

swm_metascore_vec = 
  swm_html |>
  html_elements(".metacritic-score-box") |>
  html_text()

swm_runtime_vec = 
  swm_html |>
  html_elements(".ipc-inline-list__item:nth-child(2)") |>
  html_text()

swm_df = 
  tibble(
    title = swm_title_vec,
    socre = swm_metascore_vec,
    runtime = swm_runtime_vec
  )
```

## Use APIs

getting a csv

```{r}
nyc_water_df = 
  GET("https://data.cityofnewyork.us/api/v3/views/ia2d-e54m/query.csv") |>
  content("parsed") |>
  select(year:per_capita_gallons_per_person_per_day)
```

getting a json

```{r}
nyc_water_json = 
  GET("https://data.cityofnewyork.us/api/v3/views/ia2d-e54m/query.json") |>
  content("text") |>
  jsonlite::fromJSON() |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(year:per_capita_gallons_per_person_per_day)
```

Look at some pokemen!

```{r}
pokemon_json = 
  GET("https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/pokemon/1")

pokemen_data = 
  pokemon_json |>
  content()

pokemen_data[["name"]]
pokemen_data[["height"]]
pokemen_data[["abilities"]]

```
